scenarios.Title: Morning Commute
scenarios.Description: You need to get to work. How will you travel today?

Choices.Text: Join a shared shuttle with a short detour
Choices.Teaser: Lower hassle, but less direct control.
Choices.Aftermath: Street congestion eases slightly and roadside air looks clearer.

Choices.Text: Take your own car to keep your schedule flexible
Choices.Aftermath: Traffic remains heavy and a haze lingers over the main road.

Choices.Text: Use a mixed route: cycle part-way, then transfer
Choices.Aftermath: Noise drops near the avenue and the morning scene feels calmer.

scenarios.Title: Lunch Break
scenarios.Description: It's time for lunch. What are you having?

Choices.Text: Pick the quickest meal bundle with takeaway packaging
Choices.Teaser: Minimal wait time, heavier disposable footprint.
Choices.Aftermath: Bin levels rise and cleanup crews face extra mixed waste.

Choices.Teaser: Slight prep delay, potentially less waste generated.
Choices.Aftermath: Lunch traffic steadies and less packaging appears around offices.

scenarios.Title: Evening at Home
scenarios.Description: You are back home. How do you spend your evening?

Choices.Text: Keep everything running while you wind down
Choices.Aftermath: Power demand spikes and evening emissions rise across the block.

Choices.Text: Set a comfort routine with focused lighting
Choices.Teaser: A bit of setup, steadier household energy use.
Choices.Aftermath: Neighborhood load smooths out and the night scene feels cleaner.

endings.Title: Eco Champion
endings.Description: You made great choices today! The environment thanks you.

endings.Title: Eco Conscious
endings.Description: You made some good choices, but there is room for improvement.

endings.Title: Eco Hazard
endings.Description: Your choices today had a negative impact on the environment.
